extensions.description: Paid calls settle with x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453). A payment-required reply is a JSON object with recommendation='payment-required' carrying: `accepts` (x402 PaymentRequirements), `pay_via_http` (POST an `X-PAYMENT` header to this URL — a real HTTP 402 any x402 SDK auto-pays), and, when the question maps to a specialized endpoint, `direct_service` (the endpoint that computes the exact result, with its own price/body/output_example). You may also pay over A2A by prefixing the message text with `x402:<signed-payment>`. Wallet-identified senders (set `metadata.sender` to a 0x EVM address) get 3 free /route queries/day; a `name` alone does not qualify. Anonymous senders pay $0.01 from call 1.

skills.description: POST /kalshi-polymarket/spread. Differences are reported in bps AND bounded by the venues' quote widths, so you can tell signal from noise; it does not claim a tradeable edge. A JOIN neither venue can answer alone. $0.05 USDC per call on Base.
